Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ConstraintActivityAnalyzer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ConstraintActivityAnalyzer
public final class ConstraintActivityAnalyzer extends Object
Builds dimensionless constraint-margin and local activity diagnostics from a qualified ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator.SensitivityQualityResult.

Every constraint requires an explicit positive reference value in the constraint's declared unit and a non-empty provenance string. Results preserve constraint registration order and retain the complete unscaled sensitivity assessment. The analyzer performs no process simulation and makes no optimizer-independent active-set, KKT-multiplier, shadow-price, or engineering-approval claim.

  • Method Details

    • assess

      public static List<ConstraintActivityAnalyzer.ConstraintActivityAssessment> assess(ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator.SensitivityQualityResult result, List<ConstraintActivityAnalyzer.ConstraintScale> scales, ConstraintActivityAnalyzer.ActivityPolicy policy)
      Builds dimensionless activity and sensitivity diagnostics without rerunning the process model.

      Scales may be supplied in any order. Exactly one scale must match every constraint snapshot; outputs remain in constraint registration order. A violated constraint is reported separately from a feasible candidate-active constraint. Soft constraints are excluded unless the policy explicitly includes them.

      Parameters:
      result - immutable self-describing sensitivity result
      scales - exact reference scales, one per constraint
      policy - explicit activity and derivative qualification policy
      Returns:
      immutable activity assessments in constraint registration order
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if inputs, scale coverage, or scale identity are invalid
